item.title: Rallying Cry – November 9, 2026
item.description: From Nigeria’s record-high formal employment to Ethiopia’s reusable sanitary pads breaking taboos, today’s wins include a new Art Gallery of Ontario expansion, and Eli Lilly’s breakthrough weight-loss pill that could transform sleep apnea treatment.
